subject: Accelerator credit escrow release conditions
messages:
From: Anika Shah <anika@northbridgeaccelerator.org>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@seedfoundry.co>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Request: partial escrow credit release ahead of demo day

Hi Vivek,

Hope you’re well — quick ask from our side. Northbridge is running an accelerated demo day on Jan 10 and several cohort companies have exhausted their sandbox credits. We have an existing escrowed credit pool with Redwood (per section 3b of the Escrow_Terms_v2.pdf). Normally credits unlock on a 90-day schedule, but a handful of startups are in the middle of live investor conversations and could materially benefit from an early partial release.

Can Redwood consider releasing up to ~30% of the escrowed credits to the program admin (to distribute to participants) on a conditional basis? We’re happy to sign a short addendum and provide a usage forecast for the next 60 days. We would still need the remainder locked until the original schedule or until specific milestones are met.

Attached: Escrow_Terms_v2.pdf and a short demo day deck.

Appreciate a quick read — demo day prep timeline is tight.

Best,
Anika Shah
Program Director, Northbridge Accelerator
Anika@northbridgeaccelerator.org

---
Attachments: Escrow_Terms_v2.pdf (PDF), demo_day_agenda.pdf (PDF)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Shah <anika@northbridgeaccelerator.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: partial escrow credit release ahead of demo day

Anika — thanks for the note and context. Congratulations on the demo day prep.

Short answer: we can consider a conditional early release, but I need to align with finance and legal on the mechanics. Two pragmatic options we usually offer:

- Option A (fast): release up to 30% immediately to the program admin, governed by a short addendum that requires a) a 60-day usage forecast, b) a cap on per-company distribution, and c) clawback language if usage exceeds the projection. No change to the main Master Escrow schedule beyond the addendum.

- Option B (commercial): release up to 40% now if Northbridge signs a short commitment to top up credits (prepaid) or commits to a Dedicated capacity purchase within 90 days — we can convert unlocked credits into a credit for Dedicated if you prefer. This path requires a 1-2 business day approvals turnaround from finance.

I’ve looped in Ben for the operational process and Laura for finance sign-off. Ben — can you outline the ops steps for a 30% manual release (what we need from Anika) and estimate time to complete? Laura — can you confirm whether finance can waive any early-release admin fee for Option A?

I attached our usage_report_Q4.csv to help baseline recent consumption.

Vivek
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

---
Attachments: usage_report_Q4.csv (CSV)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: partial escrow credit release ahead of demo day

Laura / Vivek — forwarding Anika’s request. My read: low commercial risk if we cap per-company distribution and include clawback. Proposed minimal term sheet below (I drafted quickly):

- Early-release amount: 30% of current escrow pool (as requested)
- Distribution control: program admin to provide a 60-day distribution schedule tied to named startups (max X credits per company)
- Clawback: if aggregate usage exceeds forecast by >20% within 60 days, the program admin reimburses excess as prepaid credits or we draw from future escrow release schedule
- Admin fee: $500 flat processing fee (waivable by finance)
- Legal: sign early_release_addendum.docx (1 page)

Operational steps:
1) Anika sends formal distribution schedule + signed addendum
2) Operations validates recipient account IDs and creates the distributions (1 business day)
3) Finance processes admin fee (if applicable)

If finance can waive fee, we can ship the addendum and release by Monday 12/21. Laura — can you confirm waiver? Also flag any accounting or audit concerns.

-Ben
Principal, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Shah <anika@northbridgeaccelerator.org>, Samir Patel <samir@seedfoundry.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: partial escrow credit release ahead of demo day — approved conditional release

Hi Anika / Samir — quick update and approved path forward. Thanks for the quick turnaround on the forecast you sent this morning. Finance has approved a conditional early release under Option A with a couple of final items:

- Immediate release: 30% of the current escrow pool will be transferred to the program admin account once the attached single-page addendum is signed by Northbridge.
- Conditions: addendum includes the 60-day distribution schedule, per-company cap (as you provided), and a 20% excess-usage clawback.
- Admin fee: waived for this waiver — no charge to Northbridge for this release.
- Timing: operations will complete the transfer within 1 business day of DocuSign completion. I’ve created a short DocuSign envelope for the addendum here: https://docusign.net/early-release-NB-1143

Next steps for you: 1) sign the DocuSign addendum, 2) confirm the final recipient account IDs by end of day Tue 12/21, and 3) operations will push the credits. Please note the remainder of escrow remains on the original schedule and will not be impacted unless you elect the commercial top-up route later.

If you prefer the 40% commercial route instead, we can discuss committed-topup terms (short form PO) — Ben and I can run that through sales.

Looking forward to demo day — happy to jump on a 15-min call if you want to walk through distribution controls.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147
